answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. A spiral of per-task receipts records who did what, and the thread of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, diluted when peers disagree, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Reaching the glacier of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
